Needs a mechanism-establishing source or the curator's ear.

standing_rules.name: Absurd Shit rule
standing_rules.source: the curator: "I'm making an 'Absurd Shit'-rule: if it's too absurd to say if it's SF or Fantasy, and it's not even a Fabulation: kill it"
standing_rules.apply: Autonomous, no per-case ask: if a book is too absurd to call SF or Fantasy AND fits no Fabulation node, exclude as not SFF. Log each kill in sweep.log as '-Title (Absurd Shit rule)' and in excluded[] with reason citing the rule.

pending_ruling.title: The Twilight of the Gods and Other Tales
pending_ruling.reason: Walked out of the communal-magic-realism split with the curator's approval, no destination ruled (the curator, 2026-09-28): deadpan ironic mythological parody, not communal magic realism; no fitting existing leaf, hangs pending his ruling rather than stretching one.

works_card.title: The Twilight of the Gods and Other Tales
works_card.placement_rationale: Actual-tree walk: Speculative fiction -> Fantasy -> Real Earth Universe -> Magic realism -> Communal magic realism. SFE calls it a collection of fables and fantasies; Gutenberg spans Arabic and Chinese tales, Roman history and Greek mythology with gods, miracles, demons and talismans treated as shared cultural reality. Community-scale inherited belief governs across the collection.
